items.explanation: A rubber band bends without breaking, so it is flexible. A stone, a glass jar, and a metal spoon do not bend.
Paper towel soaks up water, so it absorbs water. Aluminum foil, a glass jar, and a stone do not soak it up.
Metal spoon is firm and does not bend, so it is hard.

items.prompt: What property does a wooden ruler have?
items.explanation: A wooden ruler is hard, so that is its property.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to learn about a material?

options.text: leave it out in the rain
look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking at it and touching it gently is safe. Tasting, throwing, or hitting materials is not safe.
